verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs state that you can send requests over HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSockets. gRPC is documented in depth (creating gRPC requests, uploading Protobuf files), and GraphQL gets schema-based auto-completion and linting. SSE is never mentioned, so one of the four protocols in the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of SSE support, WebSocket-specific depth beyond a single mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the multi-protocol support.
